image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of an African crocodile's head and upper jaw. The image highlights the textured, armored skin (scutes), a visible eye with a vertical pupil, and an open mouth displaying interlocking conical teeth. The background is a blurred, out-of-focus green/brown, suggesting a natural habitat.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nostrils, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure appears broad and robust.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is clearly open in this image, not closed. While teeth are visible, the specific condition 'when mouth is closed' cannot be verified, and the interlocking nature is partially obscured by the open jaw angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned high on the skull (dorsal). The pupil is clearly a vertical slit. The nictitating membrane is not clearly deployed but the eye structure is anatomically correct for the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are visible at the anterior end of the snout, consistent with the taxonomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and neck are visible; the full body length and armor cannot be assessed from this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin on the head and neck shows heavy, irregular, bony textures consistent with osteoderms/scutes, though the 'longitudinal rows' pattern is more typical of the back which is less visible here.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is greyish-brown and the texture is visibly rough and granular, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral (belly) surface is not visible in this side-profile head shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are completely outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.

artifact_observations.location: Lower jaw gum line and tooth bases
artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the teeth and the gum/jawbone is slightly soft and lacks the crisp biological definition seen in high-resolution wildlife photography. There is a slight 'waxy' or smoothed appearance to the inner mouth tissue.

artifact_observations.location: Tip of the lower jaw (left edge)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The very tip of the lower jaw seems to fade into the background blur somewhat unnaturally, lacking a distinct hard edge where the bone should terminate sharply against the depth of field.
